Prevention: Purchase certified clean seed to avoid introduction through contamination
Clean tools and farm machinery to prevent spread of weed seeds
Control established populations near waterways to prevent spread during flooding and storm events
Early ploughing and proper land preparation before planting, can help smother the weed
Short lived seed bank (up to 3 years) means can be eradicated from farm with due diligence to preventing seed set
Monitoring: Sturdy, erect annual grass (up to 4m), ususally with many tillers, characterised by brace roots near the base of the plant, cylindrical spikelets with jointed seeds that break- off as they mature, and iritating hairs on leaf sheath that can penetrate skin
Inspect the crop fields weekly after sowing for the presence of itchgrass
Direct Control: Hoe once (3-4 weeks after sowing) for moderate infestation, however if severe infestation additional weeding may be needed berfore heading of the crop.
Hand pulling between crop plants improves efficacy
Remove any individual large plants in field margins etc before seed set
Inter-cropping maize with beans helps in controling itch grass weed
Restrictions: Use of chemical herbicides can lead to the development of herbicide resistance
this is particularly evident with itch grass
When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage
